name: Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (GBP)
oneLiner: GBPSAFO is the GBP share class of Spiko's Amundi-managed UCITS overnight-swap fund, authorized by France's AMF.
collateral: GBP share class of the Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund. The September 2026 prospectus permits bonds, equities and money-market instruments hedged through total-return swaps with one or more counterparties. Its GBP objective is SONIA + 0.50% before share-class fees; BNP Paribas is identified as the initial counterparty. CACEIS Bank is the depositary.
pegMechanism: GBP-denominated NAV-accreting UCITS share class with KYC-gated subscriptions and redemptions at daily fund NAV through Spiko. Orders are centralized by 15:00 Paris time; ordinary redemption settles D+1, subject to the currency market being open. The management company may cap redemptions when net requests reach 25% of sub-fund net assets; the trigger is the same for all share classes, with at most 20 valuation days of capping over three months. Unexecuted orders carry over without priority; suspension and swing pricing can also limit or delay exit.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact GBP share class FR0014015LF8 of Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund, fund UUID 59c2c924-ebf8-492d-a4b0-72d72ebf61e6, is proportional UCITS portfolio ownership with portfolio-wide total-return swaps, a possible unswapped money-market UCITS sleeve and legal separation. The issuer share-class API identifies eight native registers and five share decimals; the 21 October 2026 fund inventory contains 100 physical equity rows, one cash row and eight signed swap legs under counterparty code 372039-BNP, with TRS at approximately 100% of net assets. This supports ucits-trs-fund, not direct Treasury or credit-fund backing, and it does not establish complete current NAV, collateral, netting or default-recovery reconciliation.
